outcome: thyroid hormone levels (free triiodothyronine, free thyroxine (FT4), thyrotropin)
cohort: 194 children aged 3-17 years who participated in the Zhejiang Human Biomonitoring Program.
finding: Both PFASs and their alternatives were associated with altered thyroid hormone levels and increased odds of subclinical hypothyroidism in children, with perfluorohexanoic acid (PFHpA) being a significant contributor.
